items.title: GRIN
items.tagline: IF YOU HAVE SINNED, DON’T LET IT IN.
items.copy: A cursed vintage board game turns a buried crime into a nasty supernatural reckoning.

items.title: CRYSTAL LAKE
items.copy: Linda Cardellini leads the Friday the 13th prequel, centered on Pamela Voorhees and the town around the lake.

items.title: STILETTO
items.tagline: A NEW SLASHER FOR HALLOWEEN WEEKEND.
items.copy: An Eli Roth-produced masked-killer story stalking a community of dancers.

items.title: WERWULF
items.copy: A medieval village, a wolf-haunted countryside, and Robert Eggers returning to folklore horror.

items.title: PARANORMAL ACTIVITY 8
items.copy: The found-footage franchise returns under filmmaker Ian Tuason. No official trailer is listed yet.
